newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finnish Oct trade surplus FIM 2.4 billion - customs.
newsitem.headline: Finnish Oct trade surplus FIM 2.4 billion - customs.

text.p: Finland's trade surplus fell to 2.35 billion markka in October from 3.02 billion in September, the National Customs Board (NCB) said in a statement on Friday.
The value of exports fell four percent year-on-year in October while the value of imports rose seven percent, NCB said.
The Bank of Finland earlier estimated the October trade surplus at 3.9 billion markka with exports seen at 16.3 billion and imports at 12.4 billion.
The NCB's official monthly trade statistics are lagging behind due to changes in customs procedures when Finland joined the European Union at the start of 1995.
